prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Official Companion Adoption Agreement", "Verified Desktop Pet Certificate"]
1: ["System Tray Companion Controls", "Your pet runs in your desktop system tray. Right-click the icon anytime to change visibility, settings, or start a chat.", "Continue Setup"]
2: ["Choose Companion Character"]
3: ["Finding Your Hidden Companion", "If your pet gets covered by open windows, click the tray icon or use the hotkey to bring your companion back to the foreground.", "Understood"]
4: ["Signing in anchors your companion to your account so your pet state is preserved across app updates."]
5: ["Crafting unique pet personality matrix and desktop behaviors..."]
6: ["Ensure the subject is well-lit from the front against a simple background for best AI generation results."]
7: ["Your Desktop Companion is Active!", "Look for the pet icon in your taskbar system tray (bottom-right corner) to control or chat with your companion anytime."]
8: ["Verify Desktop Appearance", "Your companion should now be floating above your windows. Confirm you see your pet on your desktop.", "Pet Visible & Ready"]
9: ["Ready-made companions take under 1 minute, while custom photo creation takes 3-5 minutes."]
